Ram Mandir donation case: Accused raided, trust members resign amid probe

Investigations are underway into allegations of theft concerning donations for the Ram Mandir in Ayodhya. Police have raided the homes of several accused, reportedly recovering significant amounts of cash. In parallel, two members of the Ram Temple Trust have resigned amidst the ongoing probe. The controversy has drawn criticism from various political groups and prompted discussions about financial transparency.
